name: Assembly
description: Three optional checks around the ceremony. None of them costs anything mechanical.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: They carry it off so well that an officer on the platform nods at them.
outcomes.failure: A neighbour notices they don't know the words and asks, kindly, where they're from.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They're loudly wrong exactly where the piano stops. Somebody on the platform makes a note.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The shape of the place: machines, radio, medical, stores. And at the far end, an elf in a plain administration uniform, whom nobody on the platform has looked at once.
outcomes.success: About a dozen departments: who runs the machines, the radio and medical. The doctor from this morning is up there.
outcomes.failure: Too many uniforms to keep straight.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They're sure the woman with horns runs the whole base.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: As success, and they would know the doctor's scrawl again anywhere.
outcomes.success: Four signatures: a flowing hand; a quick doctor's scrawl; HYUCK in capitals, pressed so hard the nib tore the paper; and small careful characters in a script nobody here reads.
outcomes.failure: It's a charter. It says what charters say.
outcomes.criticalFailure: A staffer tells them confidently that the original burned and this is a copy. It isn't.
